intro: Explore Salou on Spain’s Costa Daurada: golden beaches, a lively promenade, family attractions and nearby Tarragona. Plan your holiday and save memorable visits and photos on your device.

areas.name: Salou town centre
areas.description: Shops, restaurants and lively streets near the main beachfront.

areas.name: Llevant beachfront
areas.description: The central beach and Jaume I promenade, convenient for families.

areas.name: Cap Salou
areas.description: Quieter coves and rocky headlands east of the main resort.

areas.name: Ponent area
areas.description: Broad beach and seafront stretching towards Cambrils.

areas.name: La Pineda
areas.description: Neighbouring coastal resort with a long beach and family facilities.

areas.name: Cambrils
areas.description: Nearby fishing town known for its marina and restaurants.

attractions.name: PortAventura Park
attractions.description: Major theme park near Salou; check tickets, schedules and height restrictions.

attractions.name: Ferrari Land
attractions.description: Motorsport-themed park within the PortAventura World resort.

attractions.name: Passeig de Jaume I
attractions.description: Seafront promenade with palm trees, fountains and places to relax.

attractions.name: Camí de Ronda
attractions.description: Coastal path with viewpoints and coves; some sections have steps.

attractions.name: Salou Lighthouse
attractions.description: Scenic coastal viewpoint on Cap Salou; check access.

attractions.name: Torre Vella
attractions.description: Historic tower and cultural landmark in Salou.

transport.name: Reus Airport
transport.description: Nearby airport serving the Costa Daurada; check seasonal routes and transfers.

transport.name: Barcelona Airport
transport.description: Larger airport farther away; check coach, rail and transfer options.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current services to Cambrils, La Pineda and Tarragona.

transport.name: Rail connections
transport.description: Check current railway stations and routes; central Salou station services have changed.

transport.name: Taxis
transport.description: Use licensed taxis and confirm fares for longer journeys.

transport.name: Walking and cycling
transport.description: The promenade is popular; coastal paths may be steep or stepped.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check UK government passport and entry guidance before travel.

useful.name: Language
useful.description: Catalan and Spanish are widely used; English is common in tourist areas.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags, lifeguards and local swimming restrictions.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Mainland Spain is normally one hour ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Theme park planning
useful.description: Check official opening dates, tickets and ride restrictions before visiting.

beaches.name: Ponent Beach

beaches.name: Cala Font
beaches.description: Compact cove with clear water and nearby eateries.

markets.name: Weekly markets

markets.name: Local supermarkets
markets.description: Convenient groceries and holiday essentials; check Sunday opening.

nightlife.name: Seafront promenade
nightlife.description: Relaxed evening stroll and beachfront dining.

nightlife.name: Capellans area

nightlife.name: Family entertainment
